title: crimew's recommendations
description: A set of client mods made to reap the benefits of modding without adding many features
body:
This pack is intended to just serve as a solid base for a modded client intending to join vanilla servers.


### Features:
- general performance mods
- Iris Shaders (bring your own shaderpack)
- Mouse Tweaks
- Shulkerbox Preview
- Distant Horizons

And that's it!
I recommend adjusting some settings to fit your machine, specifically Distant Horizon's and Sodium's settings.
